description: Full-scale dimensional and mass mock-up of the Buran orbiter (izdeliye 0.04; 4M; 11F35 ML1); delivered to Baikonur December 1983 and used for fit checks with the Energia launch vehicle and for pre-launch procedure rehearsal; left after programme cancellation on the open firing-test pad at Site 254; moved in January 2007 to Site 2 following looting and placed on a guarded standing beside the Cosmodrome Museum; finished to resemble the flown Buran orbiter; this is a mock-up and NOT the flight article — Buran 1.01 was destroyed in the 2002 hangar roof collapse
aliases: OK-ML1; OKML1; BTS-001; izdeliye 0.04; 11F35 ML1; BTS001
